"pass" : "fail"; ⏎ const expected = item.label; ⏎ if (actual === expected) { ⏎ agree++; ⏎ if (actual === "pass") { ⏎ truePositives++; ⏎ } ⏎ } else { ⏎ disagreements.push({ ⏎ spec: item.spec, ⏎ expected, ⏎ actual, ⏎ source: item.source, ⏎ }); ⏎ if (actual === "pass" && expected === "fail") { ⏎ falsePositives++; ⏎ } else if (actual === "fail" && expected === "pass") { ⏎ falseNegatives++; ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ const precision = truePositives + falsePositives === 0 ?
